Private Practice Strategy for Clinicians
Built to heal others.
Now let's build something that sustains you.
You've done everything right. Now it's time to build a practice that works for your life — not the other way around.
Let's see if we're a fit.
Apply Now ->
Grow Your Practice Without Losing Yourself
"I know this season because I lived it."
"My days used to look like 25+ sessions, a full day at the dialysis center, bedtime routines, and late-night note taking — because it was the only time I had."

I didn't grow up seeing therapy, private practice, or entrepreneurship modeled. I learned everything the hard way — juggling agency work, PRN shifts, motherhood, and clinical hours while trying to build something bigger for my family and myself.

I was completely drained. Billing errors, insurance headaches, audits, DIY-ing a business with no roadmap and no one in my corner who truly understood both the clinical world and the business side of it.

So I made changes. I invested in real support. I built systems. I raised my rates. I created boundaries. I stepped into leadership. I went from agency burnout to a six-figure solo practice — and then expanded into a thriving group practice, all while working on my doctorate and raising a family.
" Now I help clinicians do the same — without sacrificing their mental health, their identity, or their joy in the process."
LCSW
Private Practice Strategist
Group Practice Owner
You've Identified The Problem.
Now Let's Build The Solution Together.
With one-on-one guidance, success isn't only possible, it's only a matter of time.
You did everything they told you to do. And you're still exhausted.

You got licensed. Built your practice. Paneled with insurances. Set up your Psychology Today profile. Invested in trainings, certifications, and marketing. And yet — something still isn't working the way it should.
You're seeing 25+ clients a week
Back-to-back sessions plus admin and billing tasks are draining you and you feel like the only way to earn more is to see more clients — but your body and your mind are telling you otherwise.
Your income is inconsistent
Some months feel okay. Others are terrifying. You don't know where your next client is coming from or when the next slow period will hit.
You can't take a real vacation
If you stop working, the business stops too. There's no system, no team structure, nothing running without you — and that's not sustainable.
You're ready for more but don't know where to start
Cash pay clients, group practice, scaling, hiring — you've seen it all on social media but you don't have a clear strategy that actually fits your practice.
This work is for the clinician who is ready — not just curious.
You Are Ready For This If..
✔ You're already generating income and ready to build something sustainable around it
✔ You're done trading time for money and want income that doesn't depend on your calendar being ful
✔ You understand that real growth requires real investment — and you've proven that to yourself before
✔ You want to lead your practice with confidence and step fully into your CEO identity
✔ You're coachable, action-driven, and willing to do the work between sessions
✔ You believe you deserve to charge rates that reflect your true expertise
You Are Not Ready For This If..
✘ You're still working toward licensure and need foundational clinical support
✘ You want someone to build your practice for you rather than partner with you in building it
✘ You're looking for a quick fix without the reflection and implementation required for real transformation
✘ You want someone to make every decision for you rather than developing your own leadership identity
✘ You're not yet ready to fully commit — financially, mentally, or energetically
Apply Now For Support
This isn't hourly consulting. It's a strategic partnership.

Most coaching in this space is transactional — buy an hour, ask a question, hope it sticks. You leave with notes and good intentions, but nothing holding you accountable to actually implementing what you learned.

My work is different. Before we even begin, you'll complete a Practice Clarity Assessment that most clinicians have never done on themselves — because strategy without self-awareness is just another to-do list.

Then we build a strategy that matches exactly where you are, where you're going, and what your practice actually needs — and we walk through it together for 3, 6, or 12 months with structure, support, and real accountability.

INTRODUCING...
BOSS CLINICIAN CONSULTING
STOP SURVIVING YOUR PRACTICE. START RUNNING IT LIKE A BOSS.

You built your practice for freedom — financial freedom, time freedom, and the ability to show up for your clients and your family without running on empty. But somewhere along the way the dream started feeling more like a second job.
We guide you step by step through how to:
Remove the guesswork and know exactly what to do next
Build consistent, predictable revenue every month
Raise your rates and get paid so you are actually living your dreams
Attract ideal clients without burning out on marketing
Build systems so your practice runs smoothly even when you step away
Transition from solo practitioner to confident CEO
Work less, earn more, and reclaim your time
Create income that goes beyond the therapy hour
It's time to stop letting your practice run you — and start building the sustainable, profitable practice you always envisioned.
FIND YOUR PATH
Every clinician is at a different stage.
Your strategy should reflect that.
Boss Clinician Consulting isn't one-size-fits-all. Choose the pathway below that reflects your current season — and we'll build the rest together.
PATHWAY A
Build Your Foundation

You took the leap. You built something from nothing — got licensed, set up your profile, started seeing clients, and figured it out as you went. But now you're hitting a wall. The income isn't consistent. Your ideal client isn't clear. Your marketing feels like a shot in the dark. You're working hard but not building something that feels sustainable yet.
This pathway is designed to give you the clarity, structure, and strategy foundation you need to stop surviving and start growing with a real plan.
Your Pathway A Milestones
Clarify Your Ideal Client
Get crystal clear on who you serve so every marketing decision becomes easier
Build Your Signature Offer
Package your services with pricing that reflects your expertise and attracts the right clients
Optimize Your Online Presence
Update your Psychology Today, website, and bio so visitors become booked consultations
Create a Marketing Strategy
Build a repeatable system that generates steady inquiries without being online 24/7
Establish Business Systems
Set up foundational systems and documentation that protect and professionalize your practice
Step Into Your CEO Identity
Make strategic decisions and lead your practice with clarity and confidence
MOST POPULAR
PATHWAY B
Scale Without Burning Out

You've proven you can build a practice. But a different kind of exhaustion has set in. 35+ Back-to-back sessions, inconsistent income, and watching others on social media seemingly cracking the code you haven't found yet.
You don't need to grind harder. You need a smarter strategy, one that builds consistent revenue, attracts cash pay clients, and grows without requiring more than you have left to give.
Your Pathway B Milestones
Income Audit and Stabilization
Identify where your income is leaking and build a plan for consistent monthly revenue
Cash Pay Client Strategy
Attract and convert private pay clients to reduce insurance dependency and increase take-home
Raise Your Rates Confidently
Develop premium pricing and communicate your value so the right clients say yes
Build a Referral Pipeline
Create a sustainable referral and visibility strategy that generates consistent inquiries
Diversify Beyond the Session
Build revenue streams that generate income without adding more clinical hours to your week
Create Systems That Run Without You
Build the workflows and boundaries that let your practice function when you step away
PATHWAY C
Lead, Hire & Build Your Legacy

You built something real. But the complexity has grown faster than your systems. You're wearing every hat: clinical director, marketer, biller, HR, and still carrying your own caseload. Payroll feels like a leap of faith every cycle.
This pathway is for the clinician ready to stop working in their practice and start working on it, building the leadership, systems, and financial strategy of a true CEO.
Your Pathway C Milestones
CEO Identity and Leadership
Make high-level decisions and lead your team with confidence instead of exhaustion
Hiring Strategy and Team Structure
Build a sustainable hiring plan from job descriptions to onboarding and training
1099 to W2 Transition
Navigate IRS requirements and pay structure changes to protect your practice from liability
Systems and Infrastructure
Build the protocols and workflows that let your practice run consistently without you in every room
Financial Strategy and Owner Pay
Create a financial model that pays you a real salary and builds toward multi-six figure revenue
Advanced Revenue Streams
Expand beyond clinical sessions with consulting, training, and supervision that grow your impact and income
Not sure which pathway is yours?
That's exactly what the strategy call is for.
Apply below and we'll talk through where you are, what you need, and which pathway will get you there fastest.
Apply Now — Let's Find Your Path
Clinicians who chose to build differently

It's both — and that's intentional. As a Private Practice Strategist, I bring the expertise and direction of a consultant combined with the accountability and support of a coach. I don't just ask questions — I tell you what I see, what needs to change, and how to get there. You bring the commitment and do the work.

Clients typically walk away with a clear marketing strategy, raised rates, packaged offers, and a path to consistent monthly income without seeing 25+ clients a week. Results depend heavily on your commitment to implementation — but if you show up and do the work, the transformation is real.

I understand the clinical world, the insurance landscape, the cultural nuances, and the emotional weight of this work. I've lived what you're going through and I know the specific path out of it.
